```{r}
theme_custom <- function(base_size = 14, label_font = "Arial") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = label_font) +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(
        family = label_font,
        size = base_size,
        colour = "black"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        family = label_font,
        size = base_size,
        face = "plain",
        colour = "black"
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        family = label_font,
        size = 12,
        face = "italic"
      ),
      legend.title = element_text(
        family = label_font,
        size = base_size,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      legend.title.position = "top",
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = c(0, 0),
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        colour = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 1
      )
    )
}


microbiome_cols <- c(
  "#D58A32",

bar_plot_merged <- function(physeq, topN, taxlevel, factor, ID) {

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Taxonomic agglomeration + relative abundance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  transformed <- transform_sample_counts(
    tax_glom(physeq, taxrank = taxlevel),
    function(x) x / sum(x)
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Rank TAXA by mean abundance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  otu.table <- as.data.frame(otu_table(transformed))

  if (!taxa_are_rows(transformed)) {
    otu.table <- as.data.frame(t(otu.table))
  }

  otu.sort <- otu.table[
    order(rowMeans(otu.table), decreasing = TRUE),
  ]

  # Identify taxa outside topN
  otu.list <- row.names(
    otu.sort[(topN + 1):nrow(otu.sort), ]
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Merge everything outside topN
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  merged <- merge_taxa(
    transformed,
    otu.list,
    1
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Ensure "Other" is named consistently
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  for (i in 1:dim(tax_table(merged))[1]) {

    if (is.na(tax_table(merged)[i, 2])) {

      taxa_names(merged)[i] <- "Other"
      tax_table(merged)[i, 1:6] <- "Other"

    }
  }


  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # TAXON ORDER
  #
  # Alphabetical taxa, with Other LAST
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  taxa_order <- as.character(
    tax_table(merged)[, taxlevel]
  )

  taxa_order <- unique(taxa_order)

  taxa_order <- c(
    sort(setdiff(taxa_order, "Other")),
    "Other"
  )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Individual sample bars
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  plotind <- plot_bar(
    merged,
    x = ID,
    fill = taxlevel
  ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Relative Abundance (%)"
    ) +
    theme_custom() +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2"),
      labels = c(
        "Reference",
        expression("Elevated CO"[2])
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_fill_discrete(
      breaks = taxa_order,
      limits = taxa_order
    )


  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Merged treatment bars
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  ps3 <- merge_samples(
    merged,
    factor
  )

  ps4 <- transform_sample_counts(
    ps3,
    function(x) x / sum(x) * 100
  )

  plotmerged <- plot_bar(
    ps4,
    fill = taxlevel
  ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Relative Abundance (%)"
    ) +
    theme_custom() +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2"),
      labels = c(
        "Reference",
        expression("Elevated CO"[2])
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
   scale_fill_manual(
  values = setNames(
    microbiome_cols[seq_along(taxa_order)],
    taxa_order
  ),
  breaks = taxa_order,
  limits = taxa_order
) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)
    )


  return(
    list(
      plotind,
      plotmerged
    )
  )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data
# ---------------------------------------------------------

ps_plot_bars <- transform_sample_counts(
  ps_gut_clean,
  function(x) x / sum(x)
)

fact <- "Condition"
```

# Test significance - wilcox tests (report medians and adj. p)
```{r}
ps_phylum_ind <- tax_glom(
  ps_gut_clean,
  taxrank = "Phylum"
)

ps_phylum_ind <- transform_sample_counts(
  ps_phylum_ind,
  function(x) x / sum(x) * 100
)

phylum_table_ind <- psmelt(ps_phylum_ind)

library(dplyr)

top9 <- c(
  "Bacteroidota",
  "Fusobacteriota",
  "Pseudomonadota",
  "Verrucomicrobiota",
  "Thermodesulfobacteriota",
  "Bacillota",
  "Spirochaetota",
  "Cyanobacteriota",
  "Planctomycetota"
)

phylum_stats <- phylum_table_ind |>
  filter(Phylum %in% top9) |>
  group_by(Phylum) |>
  summarise(
    n_Reference = sum(Condition == "Reference"),
    n_Elevated = sum(Condition == "Elevated CO2"),
    Reference_mean = mean(Abundance[Condition == "Reference"]),
    Elevated_mean = mean(Abundance[Condition == "Elevated CO2"]),
    Reference_median = median(Abundance[Condition == "Reference"]),
    Elevated_median = median(Abundance[Condition == "Elevated CO2"]),
    p_value = wilcox.test(
      Abundance ~ Condition
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj)

View(phylum_stats)
```

# All samples, supplementary
```{r}
# ============================================================
# PHYLUM STACKED BAR PLOT — ALL QC'D SAMPLES
# ============================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Get ASV table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_qc))

if (taxa_are_rows(ps_qc)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

otu <- as.data.frame(otu)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Get phylum for every ASV
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_qc))

phylum <- tax$Phylum
names(phylum) <- rownames(tax)

phylum[is.na(phylum) | phylum == ""] <- "Unclassified"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Match ASVs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

common_asvs <- intersect(
  colnames(otu),
  names(phylum)
)

otu <- otu[, common_asvs, drop = FALSE]
phylum <- phylum[common_asvs]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Convert each sample to relative abundance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rel_abund <- sweep(
  otu,
  1,
  rowSums(otu),
  "/"
) * 100

# Check: every sample should equal 100
print(rowSums(rel_abund))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Aggregate ASVs to phylum
# ------------------------------------------------------------

phylum_df <- sapply(
  unique(phylum),
  function(p) {
    rowSums(
      rel_abund[, phylum == p, drop = FALSE]
    )
  }
)

phylum_df <- as.data.frame(phylum_df)

# Check: every sample should equal 100
print(rowSums(phylum_df))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Select top 20 phyla
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mean_abundance <- colMeans(phylum_df)

# Identify top 20 phyla by mean abundance
top20 <- names(
  sort(
    mean_abundance[
      names(mean_abundance) != "Unclassified"
    ],
    decreasing = TRUE
  )
)[1:20]

# Sort the selected top 20 alphabetically
top20 <- sort(top20)

# Everything outside the top 20 becomes Other
plot_df <- phylum_df %>%
  mutate(
    Other = rowSums(
      across(
        -all_of(top20)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(top20),
    Other
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Convert to long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_df$SampleID <- rownames(plot_df)

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -SampleID,
    names_to = "Phylum",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Check final plotted data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_long %>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  summarise(
    total = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Add sample metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

metadata_plot <- data.frame(
  sample_data(ps_qc)
)

metadata_plot$SampleID <- rownames(metadata_plot)

plot_long <- plot_long %>%
  left_join(
    metadata_plot,
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Order samples and create display labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_order <- c(
  
  # Controls / blanks
  "Bacterial_Standard_S36",
  "Extraction_Blank1_S33",
  "Extraction_Blank2_S34",
  "Extraction_Blank3_S35",
  "Extraction_Blank4_S68",
  "Extraction_Blank5_S46",
  "Extraction_Blank6_S58",

  paste0("Shikine_C", 1:16, "_S", 1:16),

  "Shikine_H2O_H3_S54"
)

# Keep only samples actually present
sample_order <- sample_order[
  sample_order %in% unique(plot_long$SampleID)
]

plot_long$SampleID <- factor(

# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_labels <- c(
```

# NMDS for all samples, then combine with the box plot
```{r}
# ============================================================
# 15. NMDS OF QC'D SAMPLES — CLR / EUCLIDEAN
# ============================================================

library(compositions)
library(vegan)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Filter rare ASVs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ps_qc_nmds <- filter_taxa(
  ps_qc,
  function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 2,
  prune = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLR transformation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clr_transform <- function(x) {
  x <- x + 1
  clr(x)
}

ps_clr <- transform_sample_counts(
  ps_qc_nmds,
  clr_transform
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. NMDS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

GP.ord.clr <- ordinate(
  ps_clr,
  method = "NMDS",
  distance = "euclidean"
)

stress_val <- round(GP.ord.clr$stress, 3)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Get NMDS coordinates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nmds_scores <- plot_ordination(
  ps_clr,
  GP.ord.clr,
  type = "samples",
  justDF = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Define sample groups
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nmds_scores <- nmds_scores %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(

      # Gut
      SampleType == "Sample" &
        Condition == "Reference" ~ "Gut: Reference",

      SampleType == "Sample" &
        Condition == "Elevated CO2" ~ "Gut: Elevated CO2",

      # Water
      SampleType == "H2O" &
        Condition == "Reference" ~ "H2O: Reference",

      SampleType == "H2O" &
        Condition == "Elevated CO2" ~ "H2O: Elevated CO2",

      # Controls
      SampleType == "Extr_Blank" ~ "Extraction Blank",

      SampleType == "PBS" ~ "PBS Buffer",

      SampleType == "Blank" ~ "H2O Blank",

      SampleType == "Bacterial Standard" ~ "Bacterial Standard",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Set legend order
nmds_scores$Group <- factor(
  nmds_scores$Group,
  levels = c(
    "Gut: Reference",
    "Gut: Elevated CO2",
    "H2O: Reference",
    "H2O: Elevated CO2",
    "Extraction Blank",
    "Bacterial Standard",
    "PBS Buffer",
    "H2O Blank"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Colours
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nmds_cols <- c(
  "Gut: Reference"      = "#2C728E",
  "Gut: Elevated CO2"   = "#D4476C",

  "H2O: Reference"    = "#0080BF",
  "H2O: Elevated CO2" = "#CC0000",

  "Extraction Blank"   = "#4C9468",
  "Bacterial Standard" = "#5B4B91",
  "PBS Buffer"         = "#F7EE7F",
  "H2O Blank"          = "#A7A7A2"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. NMDS plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clr_nMDS_qc <- ggplot(
  nmds_scores,
  aes(
    x = NMDS1,
    y = NMDS2,
    colour = Group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = nmds_cols,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2",
    colour = NULL
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = paste0("Stress = ", stress_val),
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  )

clr_nMDS_qc
```

# Phyloflash, Phylum-level
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ----------------------------
# Load phyloFlash tables
# ----------------------------

files <- list.files(
  "Phyloflash",
  pattern = "NTUfull_abundance.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

phyloflash <- map_dfr(files, function(f){

  sample <- gsub(
    "\\.phyloFlash\\.NTUfull_abundance\\.csv",
    "",
    basename(f)
  )

  read.csv(
    f,
    header = FALSE,
    col.names = c("Taxonomy","Count")
  ) %>%
    mutate(Sample = sample)

})

# ----------------------------
# Split taxonomy
# ----------------------------

phyloflash <- phyloflash %>%
  separate(
    Taxonomy,
    into = c(
      "Domain",
      "Phylum",
      "Class",
      "Order",
      "Family",
      "Genus",
      "Species"
    ),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Treatment
# ----------------------------

phyloflash <- phyloflash %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      grepl("_C", Sample) ~ "Reference",
      grepl("_H", Sample) ~ "Elevated CO2"
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# Bacteria only
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_bac <- phyloflash %>%
  filter(Domain == "Bacteria") %>%
  filter(!grepl("Chloroplast", Order))

# ----------------------------
# Relative abundance
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_bac <- phyloflash_bac %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    RelAbundance = Count / sum(Count) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# Phylum abundance
# ----------------------------

phylum_df <- phyloflash_bac %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Treatment,
    Phylum
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(RelAbundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Top phyla
# ----------------------------

top_phyla <- phylum_df %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^\\(", Phylum)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

# ----------------------------
# Collapse to Other
# ----------------------------

phylum_plot <- phylum_df %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = case_when(
      grepl("^\\(", Phylum) ~ "Other",
      Phylum %in% top_phyla ~ Phylum,
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Treatment,
    Phylum
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Mean abundance per treatment
# ----------------------------

phylum_grouped <- phylum_plot %>%
  group_by(
    Treatment,
    Phylum
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = mean(Abundance),

  )

phylum_grouped$Phylum <- factor(

) +
```

# Ordination plots
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

family_table <- phyloflash_bac %>%
  mutate(
    Family = ifelse(
      is.na(Family) |
      Family == "" |
      grepl("^\\(", Family),
      "Unclassified",
      Family
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Treatment, Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Family,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

meta <- family_table %>%
  select(Sample, Treatment)

otu <- family_table %>%
  select(-Sample, -Treatment)

rownames(otu) <- family_table$Sample
rownames(meta) <- family_table$Sample

meta$Condition <- factor(
  meta$Treatment,
  levels = c("Reference","Elevated CO2")
)

library(vegan)

otu.rel <- decostand(
  otu,
  method = "total"
)

GP.ord <- metaMDS(
  otu.rel,
  distance = "bray",
  trymax = 100
)

adonis_res <- adonis2(
  vegdist(otu.rel, method = "bray") ~ Condition,
  data = meta
)

adonis_res

F_val <- round(adonis_res$F[1], 2)
p_val <- adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]

if(p_val < 0.001){
  adonis_label <- paste0(
    "italic(F)==", F_val,
    "*','~italic(p)<0.001~'***'"
  )
} else {
  adonis_label <- paste0(
    "italic(F)==", F_val,
    "*','~italic(p)==", signif(p_val, 2)
  )
}

mds.scores <- as.data.frame(scores(GP.ord, display = "sites"))

mds.scores$Condition <- meta$Condition

veganCovEllipse <- function(cov, center = c(0,0), scale = 1, npoints = 100){
  theta <- (0:npoints) * 2*pi/npoints
  Circle <- cbind(cos(theta), sin(theta))
  t(center + scale * t(Circle %*% chol(cov)))
}

df_ellipse <- do.call(rbind,
  lapply(levels(mds.scores$Condition), function(g){

    group_data <- mds.scores[
      mds.scores$Condition == g,
    ]

    cov_data <- cov.wt(
      cbind(group_data$NMDS1,
            group_data$NMDS2),
      wt = rep(1/nrow(group_data),
               nrow(group_data))
    )$cov

    center <- c(
      mean(group_data$NMDS1),
      mean(group_data$NMDS2)
    )

    ellipse <- veganCovEllipse(
      cov_data,
      center
    )

    data.frame(
      NMDS1 = ellipse[,1],
      NMDS2 = ellipse[,2],
      Condition = g
    )
  })
)

library(ggplot2)

stress_val <- round(GP.ord$stress, 3)
stress_label <- paste0("Stress = ", stress_val)

disp.pal1 <- c(
  "Reference" = "#2C728E",
  "Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C"
)

nMDS_phyloflash <- ggplot(
  mds.scores,
  aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, colour = Condition)
) +

  geom_point(size = 2) +

  geom_path(
    data = df_ellipse,
    aes(
      x = NMDS1,
      y = NMDS2,
      colour = Condition,
      group = Condition
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = disp.pal1
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = stress_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 2.8,
    size = 4
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = adonis_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.25,
    size = 4,
    parse = TRUE
  )

nMDS_phyloflash
```

# CLR
```{r}
library(compositions)
library(vegan)

# -----------------------------
# CLR transform
# -----------------------------

otu_clr <- clr(as.matrix(otu) + 1)

# Euclidean distance on CLR data
clr_dist <- dist(otu_clr, method = "euclidean")

# NMDS
set.seed(123)

GP.ord.clr <- metaMDS(
  clr_dist,
  trymax = 100
)

# Stress
stress_val <- round(GP.ord.clr$stress, 3)
stress_label <- paste0("Stress = ", stress_val)

# PERMANOVA
adonis_clr <- adonis2(
  clr_dist ~ Condition,
  data = meta,
  permutations = 999
)

adonis_clr

F_val <- round(adonis_clr$F[1], 2)
p_val <- adonis_clr$`Pr(>F)`[1]

if(p_val < 0.001){
  adonis_label <- paste0(
    "italic(F)==", F_val,
    "*','~italic(p)<0.001~'***'"
  )
} else {
  adonis_label <- paste0(
    "italic(F)==", F_val,
    "*','~italic(p)==", signif(p_val, 2)
  )
}

clr_scores <- as.data.frame(
  scores(GP.ord.clr, display = "sites")
)

clr_scores$Condition <- meta$Condition

df_ellipse_clr <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(levels(clr_scores$Condition), function(g){

    group_data <- clr_scores[
      clr_scores$Condition == g,
    ]

    cov_data <- cov.wt(
      cbind(group_data$NMDS1,
            group_data$NMDS2),
      wt = rep(1/nrow(group_data),
               nrow(group_data))
    )$cov

    center <- c(
      mean(group_data$NMDS1),
      mean(group_data$NMDS2)
    )

    ellipse <- veganCovEllipse(
      cov_data,
      center
    )

    data.frame(
      NMDS1 = ellipse[,1],
      NMDS2 = ellipse[,2],
      Condition = g
    )
  })
)

clr_nMDS <- ggplot(
  clr_scores,
  aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, colour = Condition)
) +

  geom_point(size = 2) +

  geom_path(
    data = df_ellipse_clr,
    aes(
      x = NMDS1,
      y = NMDS2,
      colour = Condition,
      group = Condition
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = disp.pal1
  ) +

  labs(colour = "Condition") +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black")
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = stress_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 2.8,
    size = 4
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = adonis_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.25,
    size = 4,
    parse = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
# Phyloflash, Eukaryotes - Family level
library(tidyverse)

# ----------------------------
# Load phyloFlash tables
# ----------------------------

files <- list.files(
  "Phyloflash",
  pattern = "NTUfull_abundance.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

phyloflash <- map_dfr(files, function(f){

  sample <- gsub(
    "\\.phyloFlash\\.NTUfull_abundance\\.csv",
    "",
    basename(f)
  )

  read.csv(
    f,
    header = FALSE,
    col.names = c("Taxonomy","Count")
  ) %>%
    mutate(Sample = sample)

})

# ----------------------------
# Split taxonomy
# ----------------------------

phyloflash <- phyloflash %>%
  separate(
    Taxonomy,
    into = c(
      "Domain",
      "Phylum",
      "Class",
      "Order",
      "Family",
      "Genus",
      "Species"
    ),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Treatment assignment
# ----------------------------

phyloflash <- phyloflash %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      grepl("_C", Sample) ~ "Reference",
      grepl("_H", Sample) ~ "Elevated CO2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# Eukaryotes only
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_euk <- phyloflash %>%
  filter(Domain == "Eukaryota")

# ----------------------------
# Relative abundance per sample
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_euk <- phyloflash_euk %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    RelAbundance = Count / sum(Count) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# Family-level abundance
# ----------------------------

family_df <- phyloflash_euk %>%
  group_by(Sample, Treatment, Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(RelAbundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Family = case_when(
      is.na(Family) ~ "Unclassified",
      grepl("^\\(|uncultured|unknown", Family, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Unclassified",
      TRUE ~ Family
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# Top families
# ----------------------------

top_families <- family_df %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  pull(Family)

# ----------------------------
# Collapse rare families
# ----------------------------

family_plot <- family_df %>%
  mutate(
    Family = case_when(
      Family %in% top_families ~ Family,
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Treatment, Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Mean abundance per treatment
# ----------------------------

family_grouped <- family_plot %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = mean(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Factor ordering
# ----------------------------

family_grouped$Family <- factor(
  family_grouped$Family,
  levels = c(
    sort(setdiff(unique(family_grouped$Family), "Other")),
    "Other"
  )
)

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_family_barplot <- ggplot(
  family_grouped,
  aes(
    x = Treatment,
    y = Abundance,
    fill = Family
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2"),
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    fill = "Family"
  ) +
  theme_custom() +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)
  )


phyloflash_family_barplot


# ----------------------------
# Save plots

ggsave(
```

# Algae + bits
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ----------------------------
# Load phyloFlash tables
# ----------------------------

files <- list.files(
  "Phyloflash",
  pattern = "NTUfull_abundance.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

phyloflash <- map_dfr(files, function(f){

  sample <- gsub(
    "\\.phyloFlash\\.NTUfull_abundance\\.csv",
    "",
    basename(f)
  )

  read.csv(
    f,
    header = FALSE,
    col.names = c("Taxonomy","Count")
  ) %>%
    mutate(Sample = sample)

})

# ----------------------------
# Split taxonomy
# ----------------------------

phyloflash <- phyloflash %>%
  separate(
    Taxonomy,
    into = c("Domain","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species"),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Treatment
# ----------------------------

phyloflash <- phyloflash %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      grepl("_C", Sample) ~ "Reference",
      grepl("_H", Sample) ~ "Elevated CO2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# Eukaryotes only + remove Holozoa
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_euk <- phyloflash %>%
  filter(
    Domain == "Eukaryota",
    Family != "Holozoa"
  )

# ----------------------------
# CLEAN FAMILY NAMES
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_euk <- phyloflash_euk %>%
  mutate(
    Family = case_when(
      is.na(Family) ~ "Unclassified",
      grepl("^\\(|uncultured|unknown", Family, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Unclassified",
      TRUE ~ Family
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# STEP 1: KEEP RAW COUNTS
# ----------------------------

family_counts <- phyloflash_euk %>%
  group_by(Sample, Treatment, Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# STEP 2: RENORMALISE PER SAMPLE (CRITICAL)
# ----------------------------

family_counts <- family_counts %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    RelAbundance = Count / sum(Count) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# STEP 3: KEEP FULL SAMPLE COMPOSITION (NO MEANS YET)
# ----------------------------

family_wide <- family_counts %>%
  select(Sample, Treatment, Family, RelAbundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Family,
    values_from = RelAbundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# ----------------------------
# STEP 4: BACK TO LONG (SAFE)
# ----------------------------

family_long <- family_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Sample, Treatment),
    names_to = "Family",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

# ----------------------------
# STEP 5: COLLAPSE TO TOP FAMILIES
# ----------------------------

top_families <- family_long %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  pull(Family)

family_plot <- family_long %>%
  mutate(
    Family = case_when(
      Family %in% top_families ~ Family,
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Treatment, Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# STEP 6: AVERAGE ACROSS SAMPLES (NOW SAFE)
# ----------------------------

family_grouped <- family_plot %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = mean(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# CHECK (MUST BE 100)
# ----------------------------

family_grouped %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(Abundance))

# ----------------------------
# ORDER FACTORS
# ----------------------------

family_grouped$Family <- factor(
  family_grouped$Family,
  levels = c(
    sort(setdiff(unique(family_grouped$Family), "Other")),
    "Other"
  )
)

# ----------------------------
# PLOT
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_family_barplot <- ggplot(
  family_grouped,
  aes(
    x = Treatment,
    y = Abundance,
    fill = Family
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2"),
    labels = c("Reference", expression("Elevated CO"[2]))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative Abundance (%) (Holozoa removed, renormalised)",
    fill = "Family"
  ) +
  theme_custom() +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)
  )

phyloflash_family_barplot

# ----------------------------
# SAVE
# ----------------------------

ggsave(
  "Phyloflash/Figures/phyloflash_eukaryote_family_clean.png",
  phyloflash_family_barplot,
  width = 12,
  height = 24,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 900
)

ggsave(
  "Phyloflash/Figures/phyloflash_eukaryote_family_clean.svg",
  phyloflash_family_barplot,
  width = 12,
  height = 24,
  units = "cm"
)
```

# Just algae
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# ----------------------------
# Load data
# ----------------------------

files <- list.files(
  "Phyloflash",
  pattern = "NTUfull_abundance.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

phyloflash <- map_dfr(files, function(f){

  sample <- gsub(
    "\\.phyloFlash\\.NTUfull_abundance\\.csv",
    "",
    basename(f)
  )

  read.csv(
    f,
    header = FALSE,
    col.names = c("Taxonomy","Count")
  ) %>%
    mutate(Sample = sample)

})

# ----------------------------
# Split taxonomy
# ----------------------------

phyloflash <- phyloflash %>%
  separate(
    Taxonomy,
    into = c(
      "Domain",
      "Phylum",
      "Class",
      "Order",
      "Family",
      "Genus",
      "Species"
    ),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Treatment
# ----------------------------

phyloflash <- phyloflash %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      grepl("_C", Sample) ~ "Reference",
      grepl("_H", Sample) ~ "Elevated CO2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# Eukaryotes only
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_euk <- phyloflash %>%
  filter(Domain == "Eukaryota")

# ----------------------------
# Clean names
# ----------------------------

phyloflash_euk <- phyloflash_euk %>%
  mutate(
    Family = case_when(
      is.na(Family) ~ "Unclassified",
      grepl("^\\(|uncultured|unknown", Family, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Unclassified",
      TRUE ~ Family
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# Algal groups
# ----------------------------

algae <- phyloflash_euk %>%
  filter(
    Family %in% c(
      "Diatomea",
      "Ochrophyta",
      "Phaeophyceae",
      "Florideophyceae",
      "Rhodophyta",
      "Corallinophycidae",
      "Rhodymeniophycidae",
      "Chlorophyta",
      "Trebouxiophyceae",
      "Chlorophyceae",
      "Haptophyta"
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# Counts by sample
# ----------------------------

algae_counts <- algae %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Treatment,
    Family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Relative abundance
# ----------------------------

algae_counts <- algae_counts %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    Abundance = Count / sum(Count) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# Fill missing families
# ----------------------------

algae_counts <- algae_counts %>%
  group_by(Sample, Treatment) %>%
  complete(
    Family,
    fill = list(Abundance = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# Mean composition
# ----------------------------

algae_grouped <- algae_counts %>%
  group_by(
    Treatment,
    Family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = mean(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Top 8 families WITHIN each treatment
# ----------------------------

top_algae <- algae_grouped %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = Abundance,
    n = 8,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Treatment, Family)

# ----------------------------
# Collapse everything else
# ----------------------------

algae_grouped <- algae_grouped %>%
  left_join(
    top_algae %>%
      mutate(Keep = TRUE),
    by = c("Treatment", "Family")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Family = case_when(
      is.na(Keep) ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ Family
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Treatment,
    Family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------
# Re-close to 100%
# ----------------------------

algae_grouped <- algae_grouped %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    Abundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# Check totals
# ----------------------------

algae_grouped %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    total = sum(Abundance)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Fill missing treatment-family combinations
# (prevents ggplot warnings)
# ----------------------------

algae_grouped <- algae_grouped %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Treatment,
    Family,
    fill = list(Abundance = 0)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Factor order
# ----------------------------

family_order <- algae_grouped %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  pull(Family)

family_order <- c(
  setdiff(family_order, "Other"),
  "Other"
)

algae_grouped$Family <- factor(
  algae_grouped$Family,
  levels = unique(family_order)
)

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------

algae_barplot <- ggplot(
  algae_grouped,
  aes(
    x = Treatment,
    y = Abundance,
    fill = Family
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.7,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c(
      "Reference",
      "Elevated CO2"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Reference",
      expression("Elevated CO"[2])
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    fill = "Family"
  ) +
  theme_custom() +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 2
    )
  )

algae_barplot

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------

ggsave(
  "Phyloflash/Figures/phyloflash_algae_family.png",
  algae_barplot,
  width = 12,
  height = 24,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 900
)

ggsave(
  "Phyloflash/Figures/phyloflash_algae_family.svg",
  algae_barplot,
  width = 12,
  height = 24,
  units = "cm"
)
```

# Algae only NMDS
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(compositions)
library(vegan)

# ----------------------------
# Count matrix
# ----------------------------

otu <- algae %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Treatment,
    Family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  filter(
    sum(Count > 0) >= 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Family,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# ----------------------------
# Metadata
# ----------------------------

meta <- otu %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    Treatment
  )

# ----------------------------
# Count matrix
# ----------------------------

otu_mat <- otu %>%
  select(
    -Sample,
    -Treatment
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(otu_mat) <- otu$Sample

# ----------------------------
# CLR transform
# ----------------------------

otu_clr <- clr(
  otu_mat + 1
)

# ----------------------------
# Euclidean distance
# ----------------------------

clr_dist <- dist(
  otu_clr,
  method = "euclidean"
)

# ----------------------------
# NMDS
# ----------------------------

set.seed(123)

algae_nmds <- metaMDS(
  clr_dist,
  trymax = 100
)

# ----------------------------
# Stress
# ----------------------------

stress_val <- round(
  algae_nmds$stress,
  3
)

stress_label <- paste0(
  "Stress = ",
  stress_val
)

scores_df %>% head()

# ----------------------------
# PERMANOVA
# ----------------------------

adonis_clr <- adonis2(
  clr_dist ~ Treatment,
  data = meta,
  permutations = 999,
  seed = 1234
)

adonis_clr

F_val <- round(
  adonis_clr$F[1],
  2
)

p_val <- adonis_clr$`Pr(>F)`[1]
F_val <- round(adonis_clr$F[1], 2)

if (p_val < 0.001) {

  adonis_label <- paste0(
    "italic(F)==",
    F_val,
    "*','~italic(p)<0.001~'***'"
  )

} else {

  stars <- ifelse(
    p_val < 0.01, "**",
    ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "*", "")
  )

  adonis_label <- paste0(
    "italic(F)==",
    F_val,
    "*','~italic(p)==",
    signif(p_val, 2),
    if (stars != "") paste0("~'", stars, "'") else ""
  )

}

# ----------------------------
# NMDS scores
# ----------------------------

scores_df <- as.data.frame(
  scores(
    algae_nmds,
    display = "sites"
  )
)

scores_df$Treatment <- meta$Treatment

# ----------------------------
# Ellipses
# ----------------------------

df_ellipse <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    unique(scores_df$Treatment),
    function(g){

      group_data <- scores_df %>%
        filter(
          Treatment == g
        )

      cov_data <- cov.wt(
        cbind(
          group_data$NMDS1,
          group_data$NMDS2
        ),
        wt = rep(
          1 / nrow(group_data),
          nrow(group_data)
        )
      )$cov

      center <- c(
        mean(group_data$NMDS1),
        mean(group_data$NMDS2)
      )

      ellipse <- veganCovEllipse(
        cov_data,
        center
      )

      data.frame(
        NMDS1 = ellipse[,1],
        NMDS2 = ellipse[,2],
        Treatment = g
      )

    }
  )
)

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------

scores_df$Treatment <- factor(
  scores_df$Treatment,
  levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")
)

algae_nmds_plot <- ggplot(
  scores_df,
  aes(
    x = NMDS1,
    y = NMDS2,
    colour = Treatment
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  geom_path(
    data = df_ellipse,
    aes(
      x = NMDS1,
      y = NMDS2,
      colour = Treatment,
      group = Treatment
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = disp.pal1
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2",
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      colour = "black"
    )
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = stress_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 2.8,
    size = 4
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = adonis_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.25,
    size = 4,
    parse = TRUE
  )

algae_nmds_plot

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------

ggsave(
  "Phyloflash/Figures/phyloflash_algae_NMDS.png",
  algae_nmds_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 900
)

ggsave(
  "Phyloflash/Figures/phyloflash_algae_NMDS.svg",
  algae_nmds_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 12,
  units = "cm"
)
```

# All eukaryotes (no urchin)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(compositions)
library(vegan)

# ----------------------------
# Remove urchins
# ----------------------------

euk_no_urchin <- phyloflash_euk %>%
  filter(
    !grepl(
      "Echinoidea|Echinometridae|Echinometra",
      paste(
        Phylum,
        Class,
        Order,
        Family,
        Genus,
        Species
      ),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# Family count matrix
# ----------------------------

otu <- euk_no_urchin %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Treatment,
    Family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = sum(Count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  filter(
    sum(Count > 0) >= 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Family,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# ----------------------------
# Metadata
# ----------------------------

meta <- otu %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    Treatment
  )

# ----------------------------
# Count matrix
# ----------------------------

otu_mat <- otu %>%
  select(
    -Sample,
    -Treatment
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

rownames(otu_mat) <- otu$Sample

# ----------------------------
# CLR transform
# ----------------------------

otu_clr <- clr(
  otu_mat + 1
)

# ----------------------------
# Euclidean distance
# ----------------------------

clr_dist <- dist(
  otu_clr,
  method = "euclidean"
)

# ----------------------------
# NMDS
# ----------------------------

set.seed(123)

euk_nmds <- metaMDS(
  clr_dist,
  trymax = 100
)

# ----------------------------
# Stress
# ----------------------------

stress_val <- round(
  euk_nmds$stress,
  3
)

stress_label <- paste0(
  "Stress = ",
  stress_val
)

# ----------------------------
# PERMANOVA
# ----------------------------

adonis_clr <- adonis2(
  clr_dist ~ Treatment,
  data = meta,
  permutations = 999
)

print(adonis_clr)

F_val <- round(
  adonis_clr$F[1],
  2
)

p_val <- adonis_clr$`Pr(>F)`[1]

if (p_val < 0.001) {

  adonis_label <- paste0(
    "italic(F)==",
    F_val,
    "*','~italic(p)<0.001~'***'"
  )

} else {

  adonis_label <- paste0(
    "italic(F)==",
    F_val,
    "*','~italic(p)==",
    signif(p_val, 2)
  )

}

# ----------------------------
# Dispersion test
# ----------------------------

dispersion_test <- betadisper(
  clr_dist,
  meta$Treatment
)

permutest(
  dispersion_test,
  permutations = 999
)

# ----------------------------
# NMDS scores
# ----------------------------

scores_df <- as.data.frame(
  scores(
    euk_nmds,
    display = "sites"
  )
)

scores_df$Treatment <- meta$Treatment

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------

euk_nmds_plot <- ggplot(
  scores_df,
  aes(
    x = NMDS1,
    y = NMDS2,
    colour = Treatment
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +

  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = Treatment),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    level = 0.95
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = disp.pal1
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2",
    colour = "Treatment"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      colour = "black"
    )
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = stress_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 2.8,
    size = 4
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = adonis_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.25,
    size = 4,
    parse = TRUE
  )

euk_nmds_plot

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------

ggsave(
  "Phyloflash/Figures/phyloflash_eukaryotes_no_urchins_NMDS.png",
```
